summary: Plumas NF lookout in Sierra County built 1914 as a 25-foot open timber tower with a platform and no cabin; removal date unknown, and no source describes the site now.

facts.design: 25-foot open timber tower with a platform and no observation cabin; a residence cabin was also built at the site
facts.status_note: Removal date unknown; the register lists it among former lookout sites
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Plumas National Forest

events.note: Built 1914 per the register's Built field; photo caption shows the tower under construction in 1914
Registered April 15, 2020 as US 2007, CA 127; nominated by Brad Eells

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register entry. The californialookouts Poverty Hill page is an index line only, so it is not cited. The mindat page for the Poverty Hill mining district returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Two WebSearch calls found no other account of this lookout. No photo URLs were captured, only the caption and credit. Height converted from 25 ft to 7.6 m. The story has no staffing, fire or access detail because no source gives any.
